eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Emerging Digital Intelligence and Generative Engineering (EDGE) aims to provide a platform for researchers, academicians, industry professionals, and practitioners to discuss recent advancements in artificial intelligence, generative AI, and intelligent engineering systems.  The conference focuses on innovative methodologies, emerging technologies, and practical applications in digital intelligence, smart systems, edge computing, and AI-driven engineering solutions. It encourages interdisciplinary research, industry collaboration, and the development of responsible, secure, and scalable intelligent systems.
